text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x design style is timeless.
MassProduct(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
DesignStyle(x) ::: x is a design style.
Evocative(x) ::: x design style is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x design style is dreamy.
Max(x) ::: x is a design by Max.
Premises:
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → Timeless(x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (MassProduct(x) → ¬Timeless(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
∀x (DesignStyle(x) → (Timeless(x) ∨ Timeless(kellyWearstler))) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignStyle(kellyWearstler) → Evocative(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignStyle(kellyWearstler) → Dreamy(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
Timeless(max) → (MassProduct(max) ∧ Evocative(max)) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then a design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
Evocative(max) ∧ Dreamy(max) ::: A design by Max is evocative and dreamy.
